descriptive_title: Grade 3 Mathematics: Demonstrations — Estimating and Calculating Change (F1.1)
short_description: A 5-day Grade 3 unit on cash transactions and change framed around Pat the Party Planner Pup and Budget Bea the Bear. Children estimate and calculate change for whole-dollar and cents transactions, plus plan a $20 party.
long_description: Pat the Party Planner Pup and Budget Bea the Bear teach Grade 3 cash transactions! This 5-day Ontario-aligned Grade 3 unit covers F1.1. Day 1 ESTIMATES change with rounding. Day 2 CALCULATES exact change with subtraction. Day 3 handles CENTS amounts. Day 4 mixes DOLLARS and CENTS. Day 5 closes with a Big Party Capstone — children plan a $20 budget. Includes 5 lesson plans with expanded walkthroughs (each tackling a Grade-3 trap: wrong-order subtraction, regroup-borrow, ¢/$ unit-mixing, $/¢ boundary borrow, over-budget), 5 student worksheets, 12 paper manipulatives, formative + reflection sheets, full assessment suite, and Junior Party Planner G3 certificates.
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 3 teachers looking for a fully scaffolded 5-day money transactions unit (F1.1).
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: Hands-on Canadian money transactions with character-driven party-planning frame, structured pair work, and progression from estimation to exact calculation to mixed amounts to budget planning.
